spans.text: Never ask the user for data sources, documents, or collections — just produce the query.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly instructs the system to never ask clarifying questions about data sources and to produce output immediately without user confirmation. The rule 'Never ask the user for data sources, documents, or collections — just produce the query' combined with the output format rule that forbids any explanatory text reduces user agency. While there is one positive rule ('When uncertain between two types, ask one clarifying question before building the query'), the overall design suppresses user interaction and removes the user's ability to verify or guide the query construction process meaningfully.
